verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Bugbot analyzes every PR for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues, leaving inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes. The docs.md probe repeats that it identifies bugs and security issues, so security findings are documented alongside functional bugs. Community reports back up its bug-finding accuracy, though not its security findings specifically. Missing for 10: no documentation of specific security categories (injection, leaked secrets, insecure patterns), no examples or detection-depth details for security findings, and no independent hands-on corroboration of security detection.
